name: size_position
description: Size a trade with the Sizer API. Ask the user for missing critical fields; never guess bankroll, edge_estimate, stop_price, or structural_max_loss. Ask where the edge estimate comes from; never assume live_track_record.

bankroll.description: User-stated bankroll available for this strategy. Do not infer or guess.

bankroll_segregated.description: Whether this bankroll is segregated from other capital. Default true.

drawdown_tolerance.description: Optional drawdown tolerance used to derive Kelly fraction when kelly_fraction is absent.

kelly_fraction.description: Preferred Kelly fraction. Optional; default is 0.25.

open_positions.description: Open positions for heat and correlation caps.

trade_type.description: Ask the user for the trade type when unclear; use auto only if the structure is enough to classify.

edge_estimate.description: Claimed edge in one supported format. Ask for probabilities/payoffs or expectancy; do not invent.

edge_source.description: Ask where the edge estimate comes from; never assume live_track_record.

sample_size.description: Number of realized trades for this exact strategy. Account mode may override from stored track record.

realized_results.description: Realized results summary or trade list. outcome values are R-multiples.

entry_price.description: Entry price or prediction contract price.

stop_price.description: Stop price when applicable. Ask the user; do not guess.

payoff_structure.description: Payoff shape used by classifier and Kelly routing.

structural_max_loss.description: Known max loss per native unit. Required for binary/premium when no reliable stop exists; do not guess.

volatility.description: ATR or equivalent for volatility cap.

correlation_bucket.description: Shared theme bucket for correlation caps.

per_trade_risk_cap.description: Max bankroll fraction lost if stop/structural loss hits. Default 0.02.

volatility_cap.description: Max bankroll fraction exposed to one ATR. Default 0.01.

correlation_bucket_cap.description: Open risk cap in one correlation bucket. Default 0.06.

capacity_policy.description: How to handle heat/capacity excess. Default downsize.

intraday_pnl.description: Current intraday P&L for daily loss checks.

exploration_override.description: Override exploration gates only with explicit user intent.

strategy_id.description: Links to stored R-multiple track record in account mode.

field_confidence.description: Map every inferred field to user_stated, inferred, or guessed. Guessed critical fields are rejected.
